caseNameFull: Protective Committee for Bonds of Old Colony Railroad Co. v. New York, New Haven & Hartford Railroad Co. and Institutional Group for Boston Terminal Bonds v. New York, New Haven & Hartford Railroad Co.
attorneys: Joseph B. Ely for petitioners in No. 1368. Henry W. Anderson, Lewis F. Powell, Jr. and Curtiss K. Thompson for petitioners in No. 1369. John W. Davis, Edwin S. S. Sunderland, Judson C. McLester, Jr., John L. Hall, James Garfield, George E. Beers, Edmund Ruffin Beckwith, Fred N. Oliver, Willard P. Scott, M’Cready Sykes, H. C. McCollom, Edward E. Watts, Jr. and Jesse E. opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

Reported below: 161 F. 2d 413.
